    Top-torsionfree vertices in a Riedtmann mesh #

    Condition (b) prevents the simple at a nonprojective vertex from occurring as a submodule of a contravariant representable. This is the top-torsionfree step in the Bongartz--Gabriel injective-resolution argument.
